name: Relational - Digital Art Clock
author: Stefan Keller
description: Wear your love of art on your wrist. Relational shows the time over a random composition inspired by the Relational Paintings of the Swiss Concrete artist Fritz Glarner. Each start of the clock brings a new one, out of more than 1 billion. Unlocked, it shows seconds and date; swipe up for a new composition, swipe down for widgets, double tap bottom left for a flashlight.
